note: K slots of the G36 libs that neither CXF nor MBL types as a temperature or a temperature difference, and that carry no displayUnit (MBL 14.0.0). Each is decided by its MBL description, quoted in why; generate.py writes the decided quantity and cdlQuantityInferred. Slots with displayUnit degC or K are decided by generate.DISPLAY_QUANTITY instead. A new such slot refuses generation until it is recorded here (test_every_k_slot_without_a_quantity_is_decided). A slot MBL declares with neither unit nor quantity may also be decided here with a unit, from the typed declaration it is wired or bound to, quoted in why; generate.py then writes the unit and quantity with cdlUnitInferred and cdlQuantityInferred and no cdlUnit (infer_unit). A unit decision other than K carries no quantity: only K needs one to say whether it is absolute or a difference. pointUnits names a slot MBL declares unit "1", or no unit, whose dimensionless number is counted in a unit (a slot with no unit takes "1" as an inferred unit), so a binder binds a point in that unit as it is: cdlPointUnit. literalUnits records the unit of a literal the static propagation cannot reach, keyed class.instance.parameter in CDL names: a factor or a sign that multiplies a value of known unit, which is dimensionless. unitOverrides corrects a unit MBL declares wrongly, after review: `from` is the unit MBL declares and `unit` the one written. The slot carries cdlUnitOverride naming MBL's unit. An override whose slot no longer declares `from` refuses generation, so a fixed MBL fails loudly.

Buildings.Controls.OBC.ASHRAE.G36.Termin.why: An MBL 14.0.0 defect. Its description is "Hysteresis for checking damper position", and it is used only as t and h=damPosHys/2 of the LessThreshold cloDam on the damper position uDam, a 0 to 1 signal (DamperValves.mo:304-305). The SeriesFanCVF controller declares damPosHys(unit="1") = 0.005, as every other terminal unit family does in its controller, alarms and system requests. A flow unit would convert the threshold into cfm and compare it with a position.
